import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np
import os

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 8,
    'axes.titlesize': 9,
    'axes.labelsize': 8,
    'xtick.labelsize': 7,
    'ytick.labelsize': 7,
    'legend.fontsize': 6.5,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
    'axes.linewidth': 0.6,
    'xtick.major.width': 0.5,
    'ytick.major.width': 0.5,
})

data = [
    ('LAMBADA',       'retrieval',      -1.0,  0.0167),
    ('HellaSwag',     'reasoning',       0.3,  0.683),
    ('ARC-Challenge', 'reasoning',       0.6,  0.35),
    ('WinoGrande',    'reasoning',       0.1,  0.95),
    ('ARC-Easy',      'mixed',          -0.7,  0.2333),
    ('MMLU',          'mixed',          -0.7,  0.2333),
    ('BoolQ',         'comprehension',   0.2,  0.7833),
    ('PIQA',          'reasoning',      -0.5,  0.45),
    ('SciQ',          'mixed',           0.1,  0.95),
    ('XStoryCloze',   'mixed',          -0.6,  0.35),
]

benchmarks = [d[0] for d in data]
taxonomies = [d[1] for d in data]
rhos = [d[2] for d in data]
pvals = [d[3] for d in data]

order = np.argsort(rhos)
benchmarks = [benchmarks[i] for i in order]
taxonomies = [taxonomies[i] for i in order]
rhos = [rhos[i] for i in order]
pvals = [pvals[i] for i in order]

tax_colors = {
    'retrieval': '#0072B2',
    'reasoning': '#E69F00',
    'comprehension': '#009E73',
    'mixed': '#999999',
}

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.3, 3.2))

ax.axvspan(-1.15, 0, color='#e8f5e9', alpha=0.35, zorder=0)
ax.axvspan(0, 1.05, color='#fbe9e7', alpha=0.35, zorder=0)

t_conv = ax.text(-0.57, -0.45, 'convergence',
                 fontsize=6.5, fontstyle='italic', color='#4a7c59',
                 ha='center', va='bottom')
t_conv.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2, foreground='white')])
t_div = ax.text(0.52, -0.45, 'divergence',
                fontsize=6.5, fontstyle='italic', color='#a4161a',
                ha='center', va='bottom')
t_div.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2, foreground='white')])

ax.axvline(0, color='#bbbbbb', linewidth=0.5, linestyle='--', zorder=1)

y_positions = np.arange(len(benchmarks))

for i, (bench, tax, rho, p) in enumerate(zip(benchmarks, taxonomies, rhos, pvals)):
    color = tax_colors[tax]
    is_lambada = bench == 'LAMBADA'

    ax.plot([0, rho], [i, i], '-', color=color, linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.4, zorder=2)

    if is_lambada:
        ax.plot(rho, i, 'o', color=color, markersize=6, zorder=5,
                markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.5)
    else:
        ax.plot(rho, i, 'o', markersize=4.5, zorder=4,
                markerfacecolor='white', markeredgecolor=color, markeredgewidth=1.0)

    text_x = max(rho + 0.08, 0.15)
    if is_lambada:
        label = f'$\\rho$={rho:.1f}, p=.017'
        t = ax.text(text_x, i, label, fontsize=6.5, fontweight='bold',
                    color=color, va='center', ha='left')
    else:
        p_str = f'{p:.3f}'.lstrip('0')
        label = f'$\\rho$={rho:.1f}, p={p_str}'
        t = ax.text(text_x, i, label, fontsize=5.5, color='#888888',
                    va='center', ha='left')
    t.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2, foreground='white')])

ax.set_yticks(y_positions)
ax.set_yticklabels(benchmarks, fontsize=7)
ax.set_xlim(-1.15, 1.05)
ax.set_ylim(-0.6, len(benchmarks) - 0.4)
ax.set_xlabel(r'Spearman $\rho$  (attention ratio vs. cross-arch. $\sigma$)')
ax.invert_yaxis()

ytick_labels = ax.get_yticklabels()
for label in ytick_labels:
    if label.get_text() == 'LAMBADA':
        label.set_fontweight('bold')
        label.set_color(tax_colors['retrieval'])

legend_handles = [
    mpatches.Patch(color='#0072B2', label='Retrieval'),
    mpatches.Patch(color='#E69F00', label='Reasoning'),
    mpatches.Patch(color='#009E73', label='Comprehension'),
    mpatches.Patch(color='#999999', label='Mixed'),
]
ax.legend(handles=legend_handles, loc='lower right',
          framealpha=0.9, borderpad=0.3, handletextpad=0.4,
          handlelength=1.0, fontsize=6,
          bbox_to_anchor=(0.99, 0.01))

fig.text(0.5, -0.01,
         'COPA ($n$=100) excluded; Bonferroni-adjusted $p$=.170 for LAMBADA.',
         fontsize=5.5, fontstyle='italic', color='#999999', ha='center')

out_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
paper_fig_dir = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_2/projects/entrainment_gated_ft/docs/paper/figures'
os.makedirs(paper_fig_dir, exist_ok=True)

for d in [out_dir, paper_fig_dir]:
    fig.savefig(os.path.join(d, 'fig2_task_specificity.pdf'))
    fig.savefig(os.path.join(d, 'fig2_task_specificity.png'), dpi=300)
plt.close()
print('Saved fig2_task_specificity')
